name: Updated A-PGD (improved step size)
description: Adaptive-step PGD with a cosine step backbone from 2*eps down to eps/k, a bidirectional multiplier bounded to [0.25, 4.0], and checkpoints at fixed fractions of the budget. Fixes the campaign attack's 40x-too-fine step range and Auto-PGD's halve-only, floorless schedule. New work; not part of any published result.
